# BoA private institute

> Independent private banking portal for account management, transfers, payments, cards, branch locations, and client support.

BoA private institute is a secure client portal. Account, transfer, card, and support pages require an authenticated session and are not publicly readable.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Entry point to the private banking portal.
- [Sign in](/auth): Secure client sign-in and invitation activation.
- [Will vs Trust guide](/insights/will-vs-trust): Comparison of wills and living trusts for estate and legacy planning.

## Optional

- [Robots](/robots.txt): Crawler rules.
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Public routes.
